title: श्रुतिबोध शिक्षण : परिचय, प्रयोजन र क्रियाकलाप ( Aural Teaching : Introduction, Use and Activities)
authors: राउत Raut, तिलक Tilak बहादुर Bahadur
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख नेपाली भाषा शिक्षण अन्तर्गत श्रुतिबोध शिक्षणको परिचय, यसको प्रयोजन तथा क्रियाकलापहरुको पहिचान र प्रभावकरी प्रयोगसँग सम्बधित विविध पक्षहरुको मिहिन विश्लेषणमा आधारित छ । व्यक्तिले आफ्नो दैनन्दिन व्यवहार सञ्चालनका क्रममा अन्य व्यक्तिको भाषिक अभिव्यक्ति सुनेर आवश्यक प्रतिक्रिया जनाउने आधार तयार बनाउने श्रुतिबोध शिक्षणसँग सम्बन्धित यस लेखले विद्यार्थीहरुमा भाषिक र भाषेत्तर ध्वनि पहिचानको क्षमता विकासका साथै एकाग्र तथा आंशिक श्रवण क्षमता विकास गराउने लक्ष्य राखेको छ । लेखमा सैद्धान्तिक पृष्ठभूमिमा आधारित रहेर गुणात्मक ढाँचाभित्र वर्णनात्मक विधिको उपयोग गरिएको छ । सुनाइ भाषा प्रयोगकै प्रस्थान विन्दु भएकाले श्रुतिबोधका गतिविधिहरुलाई प्रयोजनपरक ढङ्गबाट अभ्यासमूलक क्रियाकलापहरुलाई शिक्षकहरुले आत्मसात् गर्ने तथा यस्ता क्रियाकलापहरुलाई आधुनिक प्रविधिहरुसँग जोड्न सकेमा श्रुतिबोधका शिक्षणका क्रियाकलाहरु सार्थक बन्न सक्ने देखिन्छ ।
american_english: The present article is based on a detailed analysis of diverse aspects related to the introduction, purpose, and identification and effective use of activities in listening comprehension instruction within Nepali language teaching. Relating to listening comprehension instruction, which prepares the foundation for individuals to listen to other people's linguistic expressions and provide necessary responses in the course of conducting their daily affairs, this article aims to develop students' ability to recognize linguistic and extralinguistic sounds as well as develop focused and partial listening skills. In the article, based on a theoretical background, a descriptive method is utilized within a qualitative framework. Since listening is the very starting point of language use, it appears that listening comprehension teaching activities can become meaningful if teachers adopt practice-oriented activities for listening comprehension in a purposeful manner and are able to connect such activities with modern technology.

informal_english: This article takes a right close look at the whole business of teaching listening comprehension in Nepali language classes, what it's for, and how to identify and use activities properly. Dealing with listening comprehension instruction—which sets folk up to listen to what others say and give a proper reply in their day-to-day lives—this piece aims to develop students' capacity to ken linguistic and extra-linguistic sounds, whilst sharpening both their keen and partial listening skills. In the paper, staying grounded in a theoretical background, a descriptive method is used inside a qualitative framework. Seeing as listening is where all language use kicks off, it reckons listening comprehension lessons could really come into their own if teachers take to practice-based tasks in a purposeful way and tie them in with modern tech, ken.
